017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.auth.oidc.rp;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import java.time.*;
022import java.util.*;
023
024/**
025 * The shipped, single-node default {@link LoginStateStore}: a single-use, TTL-bounded, size-bounded
026 * in-memory store for the per-login {@code state} &rarr; {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin} association
027 * created during {@link OidcRelyingParty#startLogin} and consumed during {@link OidcRelyingParty#completeLogin}.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * Security properties (see OpenID Connect Core &sect;3.1.2.1 and the RP charter):
031 * <ul>
032 *    <li><b>Single-use</b> &mdash; {@link #consume(String)} atomically removes the entry under a monitor, so a
033 *       replayed callback with the same {@code state} fails.  Cross-node single-use requires a shared store
034 *       with an atomic consume primitive (see {@link LoginStateStore#consume(String)}); this impl only
035 *       guarantees single-use within one JVM.
036 *    <li><b>TTL-bounded</b> &mdash; entries at or past their framework-minted {@code expiresAt} are treated as a
037 *       miss and swept.
038 *    <li><b>Size-bounded</b> &mdash; a cap (default 10 000) prevents unbounded growth from abandoned
039 *       login attempts.  When the store is full of unexpired entries, new logins are rejected (the store throws)
040 *       rather than evicting pending ones, so in-flight logins cannot be displaced by a flood.
041 * </ul>
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * The framework mints {@code createdAt}/{@code expiresAt} on the {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin} record;
045 * this impl persists them verbatim and does not stamp timestamps of its own.  The {@code ttl} argument here
046 * only bounds sweep/GC of abandoned entries and asserts the framework's {@code (0, MAX_TTL]} ceiling for the
047 * default path; the relying party re-checks {@code expiresAt} independently on consume.
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * Thread-safe.
051 *
052 * @since 10.0.0
053 */
054public class InMemoryLoginStateStore implements LoginStateStore {
055
056   /** Default maximum number of in-flight login attempts retained. */
057   public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_ENTRIES = 10_000;
058
059   /** Default time-to-live for a pending login (the user has at most a few minutes at the IdP). */
060   public static final Duration DEFAULT_TTL = Duration.ofMinutes(5);
061
062   private final int maxEntries;
063   private final Clock clock;
064   private final Map<String,PendingLogin> entries;
065   private final Object lock = new Object();
066
067   /**
068    * Constructor.
069    *
070    * @param ttl The single-use TTL.  Must be positive and not exceed {@link LoginStateStore#MAX_TTL}.  Bounds
071    *    sweep of abandoned entries and asserts the framework ceiling for the default path; per-entry expiry is
072    *    driven by the framework-minted {@link LoginStateStore.PendingLogin#expiresAt()}.
073    * @param maxEntries The size cap.  Must be positive.
074    * @param clock The clock for TTL sweeping.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
075    */
076   public InMemoryLoginStateStore(Duration ttl, int maxEntries, Clock clock) {
077      reqnn("ttl", ttl);
078      req(!ttl.isZero() && !ttl.isNegative(), "ttl must be positive");
079      req(ttl.compareTo(MAX_TTL) <= 0, "ttl must not exceed 30 minutes (was %s)", ttl);
080      req(maxEntries > 0, "maxEntries must be positive (was %s)", maxEntries);
081      this.maxEntries = maxEntries;
082      this.clock = reqnn("clock", clock);
083      this.entries = new HashMap<>();
084   }
085
086   @Override /* LoginStateStore */
087   public void store(String state, PendingLogin pending) {
088      reqnb("state", state);
089      reqnn("pending", pending);
090      var now = clock.instant();
091      synchronized (lock) {
092         sweepExpired(now);
093         if (entries.size() >= maxEntries && ! entries.containsKey(state))
094            throw new IllegalStateException("Login state store is full");
095         entries.put(state, pending);
096      }
097   }
098
099   @Override /* LoginStateStore */
100   public Optional<PendingLogin> consume(String state) {
101      if (state == null)
102         return oe();
103      var now = clock.instant();
104      synchronized (lock) {
105         var p = entries.remove(state);
106         if (p == null)
107            return oe();
108         if (isExpired(p, now))
109            return oe();
110         return o(p);
111      }
112   }
113
114   /**
115    * Returns the current entry count.  Primarily for tests and metrics.
116    *
117    * @return The entry count.
118    */
119   public int size() {
120      synchronized (lock) {
121         return entries.size();
122      }
123   }
124
125   private boolean isExpired(PendingLogin p, Instant now) {
126      var exp = p.expiresAt();
127      if (exp == null)
128         return true;
129      return !now.isBefore(exp);
130   }
131
132   private void sweepExpired(Instant now) {
133      entries.values().removeIf(p -> isExpired(p, now));
134   }
135}
